list.title: Patients
list.searchLabel: Search by name or patient ID
list.searchHint: You can type a patient ID with or without the dashes.
list.emptyHint: Patients you register will appear here.
list.noResultsHint: Check the spelling, or try just the first few letters of the name.
list.researcherBlockedHint: The named patient register is not available in this role. Use the research export instead.

register.title: Register a patient
register.demographicsHint: Only name, date of birth and sex are required.
register.respiratoryHint: Tick anything the patient has had. Ask each question out loud.
register.familyHint: Ask about people the patient lives with, not only blood relatives.
register.askedAll: I asked every question on this list
register.askedAllHint: Tick this so the record shows the unticked questions were answered no, rather than skipped.
register.draftRestored: We brought back what you had already typed.
register.savedBody: The patient ID is {{id}}. Write it on the patient's form.
register.failed: The patient could not be saved. Nothing was lost — try again.
register.fixErrors: Check the highlighted questions before saving.

field.name: Full name
field.nameHint: As written on the patient's own records.
field.contactHint: A neighbour's number is fine if the patient has none.

consent.title: Informed consent
consent.draftWarningTitle: This consent text is a draft
consent.draftWarningBody: It has not been approved by a practitioner or an ethics reviewer. Do not use it to enrol a real participant.
consent.outstandingTitle: Still to be settled before approval
consent.readAloud: Read this to the patient in a language they understand.
consent.languageNotice: This text is available in English only. A Filipino version has not been prepared and must not be improvised or machine-translated.
consent.statusHint: Record what the patient actually said, including if they declined.
consent.notRecordedHint: Record the patient's answer before taking any recordings.

detail.title: Patient record
detail.studyIdHint: Used for research. It carries no personal details.
detail.notAskedNote: Questions not listed here were not asked.
detail.notFoundHint: It may belong to another health worker, or the ID may be wrong.

care.assignHint: The person you choose will see this patient in their own list.

account.notLinkedHint: Link an account so the patient can see their own results.

error.BIRTH_DATE_MALFORMED: Enter the date as year, month and day.
error.BIRTH_DATE_NOT_A_REAL_DATE: That date does not exist. Check the day and month.
error.BIRTH_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date of birth cannot be in the future.
error.BIRTH_DATE_TOO_LONG_AGO: That date of birth is too long ago. Check the year.
error.CONTACT_TOO_LONG: That contact number is too long.
error.HISTORY_UNKNOWN_CODE: That answer is not one we recognise.
error.CONSENT_DOCUMENT_UNKNOWN: The consent text could not be found. Do not record consent.
error.CONSENT_RECORDER_REQUIRED: You must be signed in to record consent.
error.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND: That patient record is not available to you.
error.PATIENT_NOT_PERMITTED: You do not have permission to do that.
error.PATIENT_ID_COLLISION: Could not create a patient ID. Try again.
error.PATIENT_USER_NOT_A_PATIENT: That account is not a patient account.
error.PATIENT_USER_ALREADY_LINKED: That account is already linked to another patient.
